messages:
karen: opened PR to clarify Solaris-7B model card limits and to add a small Python snippet for batched embeddings (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1742). Main asks: explicit seq_limits, shard guidance, and a note about q4 behavior.

matt: can you paste the current limits table here so I can sanity-check numbers?

karen: sure:
```
variant | seq_limit | recommended_shards
solaris-7b-full | 4096 | 1 shard per 75 QPS
solaris-7b-q4 | 4096 | 1 shard per 60 QPS (~15-20% perf drop)
```

irfan: nit: change "1 shard per 75 QPS" -> "~1 shard per 75 QPS (estimate)" and add a note that peak QPS should be used for sizing.

matt: also add a short bench pointer and conservative perf delta for q4 on A10G: "~15-25% depending on batch size" with link to bench run https://bench.redwood/runs/1742-solaris.

karen: adding bench link and phrasing. Draft Python snippet for docs: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# tune batch_size to trade off memory vs latency
embs = client.embeddings.create(model='solaris-7b-full', input=["doc1","doc2"], batch_size=8)
print(len(embs))
```

irfan: small SDK v3 note: parameter is batchSize in JS — mention migration tip in the card. Also add anchor to sharding guide.

matt: found one broken relative link to /docs/guides/sharding -> fixed to /docs/ops/sharding-estimates in the PR.

karen: thanks, updated. docs-ci: preview?

docs-ci: preview deployed -> https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/solaris-7b (status: success) :white_check_mark:

irfan: LGTM from docs side. matt?

matt: approved. merging in 5 if no objections.

karen: merged. changelog: "Solaris-7B: clarified seq limits and shard sizing guidance, added batched embeddings snippet, noted q4 perf delta and bench links."
